overviewParagraphs: Located just under an hour from central Bangkok, Thai Country Club is widely recognized as one of the finest golf clubs in Asia. Designed to exacting PGA Tour standards by Denis Griffiths, the course gained global fame when Tiger Woods cruised to victory here in the 1997 Asian Honda Classic.

The layout is a masterpiece of neo-classic parkland design, featuring undulating fairways, deep strategically placed bunkers, and water hazards that come into play on nearly every hole. The conditions are consistently immaculate, with lightning-fast greens and perfectly manicured rough.

Beyond the golf, Thai Country Club is famous for its luxurious amenities. The magnificent clubhouse, managed by The Peninsula Hotels group, offers unmatched five-star hospitality, award-winning dining, and some of the best locker room facilities in the golfing world. It is the gold standard for premium golf in Bangkok.

curatorBriefHtml: Thai Country Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Bangkok, Thailand, crafted by Denis Griffiths (1996) and stretching to 7,097 Yards across a parkland environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its peninsula hotel group 5-star hospitality (Legendary service culture) and classic american parkland conditioning (Flawless fairway grooming).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Thai Country Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Thailand dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its impeccable pga-level caddie etiquette (Elite tournament caddies), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Bangkok golf tour by AGS, Thai Country Club provides a distinct architectural test by Denis Griffiths that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (impeccable pga-level caddie etiquette (Elite tournament caddies)), and private VIP transfers from your Bangkok hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Thai Country Club?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Thai Country Club's classic american parkland conditioning (Flawless fairway grooming) alongside peninsula hotel group 5-star hospitality (Legendary service culture). faqs.a: November through February is the prime season for Bangkok golf, offering comfortable temperatures and dry conditions.
